title: Durable Streaming (T-56987678)
description: Observability for SSE stream lifecycle, APNs silent push delivery, event_index gap detection, and the modern-vocab rollout gate. Every panel maps 1:1 to a metric emitted by src/observability/streaming.rs. If a panel goes blank, the emission site in handlers/chat_stream.rs, handlers/conversation_worker.rs, or apns/silent_fanout.rs regressed — NOT the dashboard.

panels.title: Streams opened (cold vs resume)
panels.description: stream_opened_total split by the `resume` label. A cold-start is an SSE open without a `starting_after` cursor; a resume is an open with one. Used to tune retention + validate resume logic.

panels.title: Concurrent SSE streams
panels.description: stream_concurrent gauge — current number of open SSE streams. Each `record_stream_opened` increments by 1; each `record_stream_closed` decrements by 1. If this drifts below 0 or grows unbounded, a close path is missing. The integration test asserts a zero delta after balanced open/close.

panels.title: Stream closes by reason
panels.description: stream_closed_total labeled by DisconnectReason::Display. normal = worker signaled terminal event; client_disconnect = TCP/HTTP dropped; server_idle_timeout = no events for idle window; keepalive_timeout = ping failed; cursor_expired = 410 Gone; error = unhandled failure. Adding a variant to DisconnectReason requires updating this legend.

panels.title: Stream duration p50 / p95 / p99 (by reason)
panels.description: stream_duration_ms histogram quantiles. Short durations grouped by client_disconnect indicate churn (app backgrounded). Long durations grouped by normal are healthy active sessions. server_idle_timeout tail tells you the idle window is too tight.

panels.title: Events emitted per second
panels.description: stream_events_emitted_total — every event pushed to a live or replay SSE stream. Counts per-event, not per-stream. Rate gives events/s flowing through the pipeline.

panels.title: Bytes emitted per second
panels.description: stream_bytes_emitted_total — serialized JSON payload bytes shipped to clients. Divide by stream_events_emitted_total for mean event size. Watch this during vocab migration — modern events are narrower.

panels.title: Resume vs cold-start ratio
panels.description: stream_resume_ratio gauge = resume_total / (resume_total + cold_start_total). Higher is healthier — means clients are reconnecting with a cursor rather than dropping the history. Near 0 means clients never carry state (check persistence on iOS). Computed inline on every record_stream_opened call.

panels.title: Cursor-expired 410 rate
panels.description: stream_cursor_expired_410_total — clients with `starting_after` older than oldest_retained. High rate means retention window is too short OR clients have been offline longer than the retention period (they should cold-start instead). Watch after any retention-window shrinkage.

panels.title: Event-index gap detection
panels.description: events_gap_detected_total — the event_index allocator returned a non-contiguous value. `gap_size = actual - expected` is added per detection. A gap means either (a) concurrent writers raced the allocator, or (b) a worker crashed mid-insert. Zero in steady-state is the health invariant.

panels.title: APNs silent push by result
panels.description: push_sent_total labeled by PushResult::Display (success/unregistered/bad_token/throttled/error) and apns_status (200/410/429/…). 410 is expected churn — it soft-deletes unregistered tokens. 429 is backpressure from APNs; the apns-collapse-id ensures the latest wake still lands.

panels.title: APNs push success ratio
panels.description: Fraction of silent-push attempts that returned HTTP 200. Dips below 0.95 indicate APNs sadness, token churn, or a regression in the fanout path. Excludes unregistered/bad_token (expected soft-deletes).

panels.title: Client session_start by platform + vocab
panels.description: clients_session_start_total labeled by platform + client_version + vocab. Emitted once per device registration. The vocab label is the gate for event_vocab_mode flip: when every session is `vocab=modern` for 14d consecutively, operations can flip to modern_only.

panels.title: Modern-vocab session ratio (rollout gate)
panels.description: clients_modern_session_ratio gauge = modern_sessions / total_sessions (since process start). This is THE rollout-gate signal for event_vocab_mode=modern_only. Operator flip rule: ratio ≥ 0.999 for 14 consecutive days. Resetting a deployment resets the counter — do not flip purely on a short window.

panels.title: Rollout gate — 14-day consecutive green
panels.description: PromQL boolean: 1 when `clients_modern_session_ratio >= 0.999` continuously for 14d, else 0. Wire an alert on `== 1` to notify operations they may flip event_vocab_mode.
